policy.title: Privacy Policy
policy.intro: At hytale.GG, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our platform.

accountData.title: Account Data
accountData.description: When you create an account via Google OAuth, we receive your name, email address, and profile picture. We do not store your Google password.

usageData.title: Usage Data
usageData.description: We automatically collect information about how you interact with our platform, including pages visited, features used, and time spent. This helps us improve the experience.

serverData.title: Server Listings
serverData.description: If you list a server, we collect the server name, IP address, description, and any media you upload. This information is displayed publicly on the platform.

reviewData.title: Reviews & Content
reviewData.description: Reviews, comments, ratings, and other user-generated content you submit are stored and displayed publicly along with your display name.

items.provide: To provide, maintain, and improve our platform
items.account: To create and manage your account
items.communicate: To communicate with you about updates and changes
items.security: To detect and prevent fraud or abuse
items.analytics: To analyze usage patterns and improve user experience

dataSharing.title: 3. Data Sharing
dataSharing.description: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information with:

items.providers: Service providers who help operate our platform (e.g., hosting, analytics)
items.legal: Law enforcement when required by law or to protect our rights
items.consent: Third parties with your explicit consent

cookies.title: 4. Cookies & Tracking
cookies.description: We use essential cookies to maintain your session and preferences. We may use analytics tools to understand platform usage. You can control cookie settings through your browser.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Data Security
dataSecurity.description: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), secure authentication via OAuth, and regular security audits. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

yourRights.title: 6. Your Rights
yourRights.description: Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

items.access: Access the personal data we hold about you
items.export: Export your data in a portable format

yourRights.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at the email below.

children.title: 7. Children's Privacy
children.description: Our platform is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us.

changes.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on this page with a revised "Last updated" date.

contact.title: 9. Contact Us
contact.description: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please reach out:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to hytale.GG. By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.description: By creating an account or using hytale.GG, you confirm that you are at least 13 years old and agree to comply with these terms. If you are under 18, you must have parental consent.

items.security: Maintaining the security of your account credentials
items.activity: All activity that occurs under your account
items.notify: Promptly notifying us of any unauthorized access

userContent.title: 3. User Content
userContent.description: When you submit content (reviews, server listings, comments, media), you:

items.own: Retain ownership of your original content
items.grant: Grant hytale.GG a non-exclusive, worldwide license to display, distribute, and promote your content on the platform
items.responsible: Are solely responsible for the accuracy and legality of your content
items.noInfringe: Agree not to post content that infringes on others' intellectual property

items.false: Submit false or misleading server information or reviews
items.harass: Harass, abuse, or threaten other users
items.spam: Spam, manipulate ratings, or engage in vote manipulation
items.scrape: Scrape or extract data without authorization
items.interfere: Interfere with or disrupt the platform's operation
items.illegal: Use the platform for any illegal purpose

serverListings.title: 5. Server Listings
serverListings.description: Server owners who list their servers agree that:

items.accurate: All server information must be accurate and kept up to date
items.ownership: They have the right to list the server
items.compliance: Their server complies with applicable laws and regulations
items.removal: hytale.GG reserves the right to remove any listing at its discretion

moderation.title: 6. Content Moderation
moderation.description: We reserve the right to remove content, suspend accounts, or take other action if we determine, at our sole discretion, that content or behavior violates these terms or is harmful to the community.

intellectualProperty.description: The hytale.GG name, logo, design, and original content are the property of hytale.GG. Hytale is a trademark of Hypixel Studios. hytale.GG is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Hypixel Studios.

disclaimer.title: 8. Disclaimer of Warranties
disclaimer.description: The platform is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of any server listings, reviews, or user-generated content.

limitation.title: 9. Limitation of Liability
limitation.description: To the fullest extent permitted by law, hytale.GG shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform, including but not limited to loss of data, revenue, or profits.

termination.title: 10. Termination
termination.description: We may suspend or terminate your account at any time for violation of these terms. Upon termination, your right to use the platform ceases immediately. Sections regarding intellectual property, disclaimers, and limitation of liability survive termination.

governing.title: 11. Governing Law
governing.description: These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with applicable laws. Any disputes shall be resolved through good-faith negotiation before pursuing other remedies.

changes.title: 12. Changes to These Terms
changes.description: We may modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms. Material changes will be communicated via the platform.
